blocks.text: The Constitution provides special procedures for exceptional situations that may threaten national security, constitutional governance in a State, or financial stability.

rows: War, external aggression, or armed rebellion.
A State government cannot be carried on in accordance with the Constitution.
A threat to the financial stability or credit of India or a part of it.

items: Who issues the proclamation and the role of Parliament.
The effect on Union–State relations and fundamental rights.
The safeguards and time limits in the relevant constitutional provisions.
